title: Boundary wall abutting an existing or simultaneously constructed wall
text: C3.4.5 Where the boundary wall abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension, that boundary wall may exceed the provisions of C3.4.4 up to the extent of height and length of the existing boundary wall.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Applied mechanically as a not_applicable exception on every C3.4.4 height and length rule (fact building.boundary_walls.adjoining_wall_exists); whether the proposed wall stays within the height and length of the existing wall is a planner check, hence judgment here.
